PURE WHITE background, one centered standalone emblem with ample margins. DO NOT render any words or captions; a neutral company wordmark will be added separately for comparison. Medium visual weight with generous white cuts, crisp vector-like flat artwork. No mockup, decorative illustration, texture, 3D, shadows, global rainbow wash, generic stock icon, business-icon collage or copied established logo.
